page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a compute-optimized, GPU-accelerated bare-metal server instance tailored for dense computational and graphics workloads. Powered by the x86_64 architecture, the platform features dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors providing 128 virtual cores operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on a KVM hypervisor. The system is provisioned with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU to support memory-heavy pipelines alongside host operations.

Hardware acceleration is driven by eight discrete NVIDIA A10 GPUs, each equipped with 24 GiB of VRAM to deliver a combined accelerator memory footprint of 192 GB. To accommodate the massive throughput demands of multi-accelerator data exchanges and remote ingestion, the platform incorporates a high-throughput network subsystem providing 160 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage, meaning primary operating systems, scratch spaces, and datasets must rely entirely on remote network block storage. This storage dependency is partially offset by the high baseline network capacity. The platform also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring dedicated network allocation. By bundling eight GPUs and 128 dedicated cores into a single physical unit, the server optimizes deployment density and administrative overhead relative to scaling out multiple smaller GPU instances. It is suitable for high-throughput AI inference, large-scale video transcoding, cloud graphics rendering, and distributed computer vision tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel computing and graphics-intensive enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it contains 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of memory at a ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The machine integrates eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs offering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM, supported by a 160 Gbps baseline network interface. Because the instance provides no local storage, all disk operations require remote network volumes. Combining dense multi-GPU compute with high network throughput, the instance avoids the administrative overhead of multiple smaller nodes. It is suited for multi-stream AI inference, distributed rendering, video processing pipelines, and data-intensive visual computing applications.
